bell_state_measurement.expected: Only '00' and '11' occur on an ideal simulator.
bell_state_measurement.noise_explanation: Depolarizing errors applied after H and CX can disturb the Bell state, so noisy runs can produce '01' and '10' and shift the ideal balance.

one_qubit_measurement.circuit: H on |0>, then a computational-basis measurement
one_qubit_measurement.expected: Approximately equal '0' and '1' counts over many shots.

two_qubit_entanglement.circuit: H on qubit 0 followed by CX(0, 1)
